info.title: API.SH: Myntra
info.description: The Myntra API from API.SH: public Myntra data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Products of one Myntra (India) category, brand or collection page (e.g. men-tshirts, nike, women-kurtas-kurtis-suits) with the site's attribute filters (brand, colour, size, fabric, fit and the rest), price, discount and rating ranges, sort and paging. Each product: name, brand, price, MRP, discount, rating and ratings count, sizes, stock and images, about 50 per page. Also the page title, sort options and every filter with its values and counts (each value carries the `filter` string to send back). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page. An unknown page answers 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/myntra-category

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: The listing page slug as in myntra.com links, e.g. `men-tshirts`, `nike`, `women-kurtas-kurtis-suits`, or its URL.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: An attribute filter `Facet:value[,value]` from `filters[].values[].filter`, e.g. `Brand:Nike,Puma` or `Color:Black`. Repeat the parameter (or join with `::`) for several facets, up to 15.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: recommended (default), popularity, new, price_desc, price_asc, discount, rating.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Customer reviews of one myntra.com product, 12 per page: rating, text, reviewer name, date, helpful and unhelpful votes, the size bought, review photos and videos, with the average rating, rating and review counts and the 1-5 star breakdown. Most helpful or newest first, and filterable by star rating. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/myntra-reviews

parameters.name: product_id
parameters.description: Numeric product id (the number in a product link, or `id` from /myntra/v1/search). Either product_id or url is required.

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Only reviews with this star rating (1-5).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Fashion products for a search on Myntra (India): name, brand, price, MRP, discount, rating and ratings count, sizes, stock and images, about 50 per page, plus the filter facets. `facets` lists every facet (primary, secondary and the price, discount and rating ranges) with value counts and, for attribute values, the `filter` string that selects it. Filter by brand, gender, colour, size, any facet (`filter`), price range, minimum discount and minimum rating; the answer echoes them as `applied_filters`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/myntra-search

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Brands, comma separated (values of the Brand facet, e.g. Nike,Puma).

parameters.name: gender
parameters.description: Gender facet values, comma separated (men, women, boys, girls).

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Colour facet values, comma separated (e.g. Black,White).

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Size facet values, comma separated (e.g. UK8,UK9 or M,L).

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Any facet as Facet:value[,value] (the `filter` strings in `facets`), e.g. Materials:Mesh; repeat the parameter or join with :: for several.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

products.name: Nike Quest 6 Men's Road Running Shoes

get.description:
The "more like this" of a Myntra product: the page's links to more by the same brand, in the same colour and in the same category (with their listing filters), the similar styles it promotes, and the first page of products from the closest link (name, brand, price, MRP, discount, rating, sizes, image, link).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/myntra-similar

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Myntra product id, or use url.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
